governance.status: ANALYTICAL LITERATURE REVIEW — HYPOTHESES NOT YET PROJECT-VALIDATED
governance.description: Audited Experiment Portfolio v2: Mechanical mathematical ranking across three separate portfolios (CFD Breakthrough, Cross-Domain Transfer, Engineering/Infrastructure) with information-value decomposition.

portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.name: Resolvent Input-Output Analysis for Boundary-Actuated Wall Shear Gain
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.target_system: Turbulent channel flow (Re=200) under spanwise wall oscillation
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.cheapest_falsification: Compute discrete resolvent gain for spanwise wall oscillation at omega=0.05. Compare predicted gain curve against 5-step DNS truth run with wall actuation. If predicted gain does not correlate with measured wall shear reduction (r < 0.70), hypothesis is falsified.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.pass_condition: Resolvent-predicted optimal frequency matches DNS wall shear reduction within 15% relative error.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.baseline: Canonical W12/W13 channel truth solver with spanwise wall velocity boundary condition.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.required_evidence: Raw arrays of resolvent singular vectors, actuator velocity fields, and resulting wall shear stress distributions saved in write-once evidence bundle.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.what_we_learn_if_pass: Proves that our discrete staggered Navier-Stokes operators accurately predict boundary actuation gain without requiring full-field forward simulation.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.what_we_learn_if_fail: Identifies that discrete resolvent approximations around the laminar/mean profile fail to capture turbulent wall-shear sensitivity without explicit Reynolds stress closure.

portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.name: Spatial Phase Alignment / Shifted POD Pretest (R_align Ratio)
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.target_system: Existing W3/W4 multi-seed turbulent snapshot datasets (Seeds 101, 104, 105)
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.cheapest_falsification: Compute raw cross-seed Grassmannian subspace distance d_raw. Compute optimally translated subspace distance d_aligned via W4 optimal_translation_alignment. Calculate R_align = d_aligned / d_raw. If R_align > 0.80, translation/sPOD is falsified as the primary driver of cross-seed POD failure.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.pass_condition: R_align < 0.30 (alignment significantly collapses cross-seed subspace distance).
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.baseline: Existing W4 cross-seed subspace distance d_subspace = 1.52 (raw).
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.required_evidence: Computed R_align scalar, optimal translation vector (di, dj, dk), and pre/post principal angle spectra exported to JSON.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.estimated_cost: 10-15 minutes runtime (pure diagnostic analysis on existing data).
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.what_we_learn_if_pass: Proves that spatial phase drift is indeed the dominant cause of POD cross-seed failure, mathematically justifying the development of Shifted-POD / Lie symmetry reduction for turbulence.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.what_we_learn_if_fail: Decisively eliminates the spatial translation hypothesis, proving that cross-seed POD failure is caused by intrinsic high-dimensional attractor geometry rather than simple spatial phase shift.

portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.name: Divergence-Free Wave-Packet Dictionaries for Inverse Sensor Reconstruction
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.target_system: 3D channel flow snapshot with localized coherent vortex tubes
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.cheapest_falsification: Sample velocity at 50 sparse point locations. Reconstruct full field using W13-G wave packet dictionary + NonorthogonalProjectionSolver. If vortex core position error > 2 grid cells compared to full DNS, hypothesis is falsified.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.pass_condition: Identifies vortex core locations and peak vorticity with <15% relative error from sparse sensors.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.baseline: Full-grid DNS vorticity field omega = curl(u).
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.required_evidence: Reconstructed vs true velocity/vorticity fields and sparsity participation ratios saved to evidence bundle.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.what_we_learn_if_pass: Demonstrates that multiresolution solenoidal wave packets have genuine utility for inverse flow sensing and coherent structure extraction, salvaging the mathematical core of W13-G.
portfolio_a_cfd_breakthrough.what_we_learn_if_fail: Proves that separable multiresolution wave packets lack the directional selectivity needed for 3D vortex identification.

portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.name: Solenoidal Modal Basis for Roberts-Flow Kinematic Induction/Dynamo Test
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.target_system: Roberts cellular flow kinematic dynamo at magnetic Reynolds number Rm=10
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.cheapest_falsification: Prescribe Roberts steady cellular velocity field u. Evolve magnetic field B using FourierSolenoidalBasis under induction equation B_t = curl(u x B) + eta * Lap(B). Measure magnetic growth rate gamma and divergence norm ||div B||. If ||div B|| > 1e-12 or gamma differs from Roberts analytical eigenvalue by >1.0%, hypothesis is falsified.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.pass_condition: ||div B|| < 1e-12 (exact machine-precision solenoidality); gamma matches analytical eigenvalue within 0.5% relative error.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.baseline: Roberts (1972) / Dudley & James (1989) analytical kinematic dynamo eigenvalue.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.required_evidence: Time series of magnetic energy, modal coefficients, magnetic growth rate gamma, and max divergence norm exported to evidence bundle.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.what_we_learn_if_pass: Proves that our exact solenoidal modal framework solves kinematic induction and astrophysical dynamo problems without magnetic monopole divergence errors.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.what_we_learn_if_fail: Reveals whether cross-product modal projection introduces aliasing errors during vector induction coupling.

portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.name: ETD Integrator for Stiff Semilinear Reaction-Diffusion PDEs (Software Smoke Test)
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.target_system: 1D Allen-Cahn equation u_t = epsilon * u_xx + u(1 - u^2) with epsilon=0.01 at dt=0.05
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.cheapest_falsification: Run 1D Allen-Cahn equation using IntegratingFactorModalODEIntegrator at dt=0.05. If integrator exhibits numerical instability or relative L2 error exceeds 4th-order Crank-Nicolson reference, hypothesis is falsified.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.pass_condition: Stable integration for dt=0.05 (10x larger than explicit CFL); 4th-order temporal convergence.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.baseline: High-resolution Crank-Nicolson finite difference reference solution.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.required_evidence: Temporal convergence table (dt vs L2 error) and phase-separation profiles saved to JSON.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.what_we_learn_if_pass: Confirms software and mathematical portability of our ETD integrator for non-fluid stiff semilinear PDEs.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.what_we_learn_if_fail: Identifies numerical issues in our integrating factor phi-function implementation under stiff nonlinear transitions.

portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.name: Clustered Local POD for Multi-Regime Bistable Structural Snap-Through
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.target_system: Bistable Duffing oscillator undergoing chaotic snap-through transitions
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.cheapest_falsification: Generate 100 snapshots of snap-through motion. Train 2-cluster ClusteredLocalPODBasis. Measure local vs global projection error. If local projection error is not at least 3x lower than global 1-cluster POD at rank r=2, hypothesis is falsified.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.pass_condition: 2-cluster local POD achieves >3x lower projection error than global POD at rank r=2.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.required_evidence: Cluster centroids, local basis vectors, and projection error curves exported to JSON.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.what_we_learn_if_pass: Demonstrates the exact operating regime where clustered local POD succeeds by exploiting multi-modal state-space geometry.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.what_we_learn_if_fail: Shows whether nearest-cluster switching exhibits transition instability during rapid saddle crossings.

portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.name: Separable Channel Eigenbasis for Acoustic Duct Resonators
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.target_system: 3D rectangular acoustic duct with rigid walls
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.cheapest_falsification: Simulate broadband acoustic pulse propagation down a 3D duct using SeparableChannelEigenbasis. Compare modal cut-on frequencies against analytical dispersion relation. If modal frequency error > 0.1%, hypothesis is falsified.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.pass_condition: Modal cut-on frequencies match analytical formula within 0.1% relative error.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.required_evidence: Frequency spectrum and modal cut-on comparison table exported to JSON.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.what_we_learn_if_pass: Validates exact acoustic waveguide mode propagation in tensor-product geometries.
portfolio_b_cross_domain_transfer.what_we_learn_if_fail: Identifies boundary condition representation errors in acoustic pressure fields.

portfolio_c_infrastructure_engineering.name: Domain-Agnostic Scientific Audit Infrastructure Package (`sciaudit`)
portfolio_c_infrastructure_engineering.cheapest_falsification: Extract `navier3d.audit` as standalone package. Run automated test suite on a mock machine learning experiment. Inject a single bit-flip into the raw predictions array. Run `audit_recompute`. If tamper detection fails to detect the bit-flip and halt execution, hypothesis is falsified.
portfolio_c_infrastructure_engineering.pass_condition: 100% test suite pass; 100% tamper detection rate on modified raw arrays.
portfolio_c_infrastructure_engineering.required_evidence: Standalone package structure, unit test logs, and CI test report.
portfolio_c_infrastructure_engineering.what_we_learn_if_pass: Delivers a production-ready, domain-agnostic scientific reproducibility tool that can be used across any computational project.
portfolio_c_infrastructure_engineering.what_we_learn_if_fail: Identifies hidden coupling between audit infrastructure and fluid grid data structures.
